### 🔴 Pregnancy Safety: Strong Caution Advised
Whole-body cryotherapy (WBC) involves 2–4 minutes of exposure to extremely cold air (typically -110°C to -160°C / -176°F to -256°F). **There is no clinical safety data for WBC during pregnancy**, and most obstetric and pain specialists recommend avoiding it, particularly in the first trimester.
